body.x: CES is the largest and most influential event in the world that brings innovation and trends in the technology sector and introduces the latest technologies that can change the world. The CES 2019 held last year ended in a successful manner with 4,500 companies, spectators and buyers attending.

The CES 2019 introduced innovative technologies such as 5G, artificial intelligence, AR/VR, smart city, sports and robots to more than 180,000 participants. More than 1,200 diverse start-up companies, participating in 50 countries, have introduced a large number of products and systems, while CES has been praised for providing a venue for opportunities for startup companies dreaming of entering the global market.

It is predicted that CES 2020 that will be held in Las Vegas on the Jan 7th will be able to look at all areas of technologies in global markets such as 5G, artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, and robots. Also, 61 percent of Fortune's global brands will participate in the CES 2020 event, which once again proves the status of CES.

Karen Chupka, vice president of CES, said, "Companies are innovating their businesses using technology in all major industries, and CES 2020 will be a global stage for the latest innovations across all areas," adding, "The show will show all aspects of global business where participants can expect things that are unexpected."

Meanwhile, at CES 2020, a number of leading Asian companies, including Samsung Electronics, LG Electronics, Hyundai Motor, Doosan, SK Telecom, Toyota, Huawei, Lenovo and Nikon, are participating to draw attention.
